name: coronatio-rust-source-bands
description: Ordered infinite-infinite preservation spine for Coronatio Rust source previously accumulated in src/main.rs.

bands.description: Constants and contract/readback structs shared by Coronatio bands.
Process entry and Axum router spine.
HTTP route handlers and native API response faces.
Legacy HomeServer asset, Unix-socket proxy, chunk decoding, and route-boundary behavior.
Dynamic tab manifest loading and validation routes.
Crown pane, registry, startup, lane, fallback, and admin-session readbacks.
Socket/SSE topic and monitor-pulse readback contracts.
Frontend persistence and service-data migration readbacks.
Boundary, installer, registry, and stats snapshot readbacks.
Exact legacy HomeServer shell rendering plus safety/shutdown helpers.
Unit tests preserving Coronatio behavior through the split.

invariants: src/main.rs remains the thin crate/process face and includes bands in this order.
Bands are included at crate root to preserve existing private item visibility during the first preservation tranche.
Behavioral extraction to ordinary Rust modules is a later typed-interface tranche after live behavior stays proven.
